description: Read the original operation’s state, work kind, current step, age, usual duration, wait reason and next step. A deployment failure includes the deployment ID for deployment_logs. For waiting_for_mail, read mail_domain_status or GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/environments/{environment_id}/mail-domain.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.
